label: SQP-style
stem: Which of these is a format error in a formal invitation card?
options: Writing the host's name at the top
Writing RSVP at the bottom left
Ending with 'Yours sincerely' and a name
Centring every line inside a box
model_answer: **(c)** A formal card has no salutation and no signature; it ends with RSVP.

label: SQP-style
stem: Which line is correctly worded for a formal invitation?
options: We would love you to come to our Annual Day.
The Principal and staff request the pleasure of your company at the Annual Day.
I am inviting you to the Annual Day on Saturday.
You are invited, please come to the Annual Day!
model_answer: **(b)** Third person with the standard formula; the others use I/we/you or an exclamation.

label: PYQ-style
stem: You are Dev/Devika living at 12, Hill Road, Shimla. Your family is hosting a housewarming on 30 November 2026. Write an informal invitation in about 50 words to your friend Sameer to attend.
hint: Letter shell: address, date, Dear Sameer, warm body with occasion, date, time, venue, request to come; Your friend, name.

parts.stem: Write the informal invitation (letter format, about 50 words).

12, Hill Road
Shimla 171001
14 November 2026
Dear Sameer,
We have finally moved into our new house, and my parents are hosting a small housewarming on Sunday, 30 November, at 6 p.m. at the above address. It won't feel complete without you, so please do come. Let me know by the 27th if you can make it.

label: PYQ-style
stem: You are Mr/Mrs Rao. You have received a formal invitation to the inauguration of the new science block of Riverdale Senior Secondary School on 5 December 2026. You cannot attend because you will be travelling. Write a formal reply in about 50 words regretting your inability to attend.
hint: Third person, boxed: thanks + occasion + date → regret formula + brief reason → good wishes. No salutation, no signature.

parts.model_answer: Mr and Mrs Rao thank the Principal and staff of Riverdale Senior Secondary School for their kind invitation to the inauguration of the new science block on Friday, 5 December 2026. They regret their inability to attend owing to a prior travel commitment on that date. They wish the school every success on this occasion.

scheme.step: Format: third person, boxed, no salutation or signature
Content: thanks to the host and the occasion with date
Content: clear regret with brief reason and good wishes
Expression: formal, polite tone, correct grammar, about 50 words

label: PYQ-style
stem: Your friend Isha has invited you to her eighteenth birthday dinner on 28 November 2026. You will be out of town for a family wedding. Write an informal reply in about 50 words declining the invitation.
hint: First person letter: thank her, name the occasion, say no clearly with the reason, wish her and suggest meeting later.

parts.stem: Write the informal reply (letter format, about 50 words).
parts.model_answer:
7, Park Street
Kolkata 700016
16 November 2026
Dear Isha,
Thank you so much for inviting me to your eighteenth birthday dinner on the 28th. I'm really sorry, but I'll be in Jaipur that week for my cousin's wedding, so I won't be able to make it. Have a wonderful evening — I'll take you out for a treat when I'm back.
Your friend,
Ananya

Content: thanks and the occasion named with date
Content: clear refusal with reason and a warm wish / plan to meet
Expression: warm, correct tone and grammar, about 50 words
